IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: the run (loop, current_id, passed_id) is the 2J facts Run; progress (conquer_lev, conquer_loop_id) is the 2J facts Progress; both change only through the owner's PrepareWriteTx/ApplyWriteTx in the caller transaction. The first INFO of an INITIAL_NO_PROGRESS player creates run {loop 1, current 10001, passed 0} with progress unchanged.

STRONG_INFERENCE (client getLoopBy shows loop-1 at level 56): clearing mission lev L sets conquer_lev = L; clearing mission 56 (next_id 0) also sets conquer_loop_id = loop+1 and restarts the run at the first mission; after loop 8 the run ends with current_id = passed_id = last mission and conquer_loop_id 9.

CLIENT_SUMMARY_ATTESTED (PASS418): START records an attempt (formation partner ids, pet, loop, mission); RESULT settles only the player's open attempt; is_win, total_damage, alive_num and the report are client attested; the server bounds them (alive 0..6, damage 0..1e15, report JSON object for a stored report) and recomputes every canonical consequence. A newer START supersedes an unsettled attempt (its chance stays spent).
Private policy (user decision 2026-10-20 'Daily + new mission'): left_times is 10 and refills at 05:00 GMT+8 each day and when a mission is cleared; START consumes one chance.

Private policy: START requires a not-ended run, a chance, 1..6 distinct owned partner ids not used in a won fight of this mission, and an owned unused pet or none; RESULT requires campaign_id = current mission, an existing unbeaten team, and the attempt's formation and pet.

Private policy: a won fight marks the team beaten and its girls and pet used for the mission; a lost fight adds one defeat buff level up to 10 (+1% per level shown by the client); report_invalid = 1 is settled but its report is not kept.

Private policy: beating every team of the mission promotes: the mission reward (and on mission 56 the loop reward) is granted through I5 and answered as awards; team status, used girls/pets and the buff reset; chances refill; the directory projection conquer_lev/conquer_loop_id is updated in the same transaction.
Private policy (user decision 'Keep it'): RESET clears beaten teams and used girls/pets of the current mission only; chances and buff stay; refused once the run has ended.
Private policy: BUY_CONQUER_TIMES requires an active monthly privilege card, fewer than 10 buys today (05:00 GMT+8 day), costs the next refresh_cost buy_conquer_cost in crystal and adds one chance.
Private policy: conquer_region is the number of regions whose attributes are open for the progress (the 2J Evaluate region rule): 0..5.

Private policy (user decision 'Best: survivors then damage'): won fights with a valid report are kept per (loop, mission, team) across servers; REPORT_LIST answers the 3 best by alive_num x 1e9 + total_damage, ties to the earlier report; other reports of that key are pruned.

Private policy (user decision 'Full mode'): the first view of another player's report by a viewer on a 05:00 GMT+8 day mails its owner 50000 gold (mana) with CONQUER_SCHOOL_MAIL_* text (count 1), at most 10 rewarded views per owner per day; report_award_times is the owner's rewarded views today.

IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION: MID1 17.conquer_lev/conquer_loop_id/conquer_region are projected from the owner's known facts; UNKNOWN_LEGACY players keep the stock defaults and the mode refuses them (no inferred progress).
